newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAI to raise A$50m in pref share issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAI to raise A$50m in pref share issue.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd said on Monday it intended to raise A$50 million through an issue of 25 million converting preference shares at a price A$2.00 a share.

FAI said the non-redeemable, non-cumulative preference shares would be placed with various funds managed by County NatWest Australia Investment Management Ltd and the issue was fully underwritten by BT Securities Ltd.
FAI said the issue was subject to shareholder approval and the stock, if issued, would have a five-year term and a dividend yield of 8.25 percent fully franked.

"At the end of the term, the converting preference shares will convert into ordinary shares according to a ratio linked to FAI's share price at the time of conversion based on a maximum price of A$1.60 per share," the company said in a statement.
FAI said the proceeds of the issue would strengthen its equity base and that the injection of funds by County NatWest would add significantly to the standing of FAI in the financial community.
